exclusions.subject: The complete text and evidentiary annexes of AMCU decision 535-р
exclusions.statement: This case reconstructs the published administrative outcome, not the authority's full reasoning.
exclusions.search_boundary: The official public sources inventoried on 2026-08-21: the AMCU news items, the decision register entry, and the two Prozorro API records.
exclusions.would_resolve: Publication of the decision text in the official register, or a lawful access request that returns it.

exclusions.subject: The complete Prozorro API responses and bid documents
exclusions.statement: The committed fixture is a data-minimized projection of the two official records.
exclusions.minimization_basis: SHA-256 digests of the complete responses are recorded in sources/source-index.json; the responses and bid documents themselves are not republished here.

exclusions.subject: Public participation, price, and document metadata
exclusions.statement: None of it independently proves coordination, intent, guilt, or legal liability.

exclusions.subject: The PDF metadata audit
exclusions.statement: An exploratory null result is evidence about what the method examined, and about nothing else.
exclusions.method: Exploratory metadata scan over 59 public PDFs, returning no shared-authorship signal.

exclusions.subject: Personal and contact data in the source records
exclusions.statement: Company names and identifiers are retained; unnecessary personal and contact data are not.
exclusions.minimization_basis: The identifiers are necessary to bind the official decision to the public tender records; nothing beyond that necessity was carried into the committed projection.

exclusions.subject: Appeals, judicial review, enforcement, payment of fines, and later record changes
exclusions.statement: All of it falls outside the frozen acquisition snapshot this case reasons over.

exclusions.subject: Automated re-acquisition of the AMCU pages
exclusions.statement: The publisher returns HTTP 403 to automated clients, so this case cannot re-read its own decisive sources mechanically; two of the three pages are held in no independent copy.
exclusions.restriction_basis: Practical restriction by the publisher's bot protection, recorded per source in sources/acquisition-state.json. It is a fact about this client, not evidence that anything was withheld.
exclusions.would_resolve: An independent archival capture of the two unwitnessed pages, or a channel the publisher serves to automated readers.
